F1: The trailing `if` has no condition, so the template cannot compile when rendering an existing topic.
F2: raw_html` returns imported content without sanitization, allowing untrusted markup to execute on the forum origin.
F3: Polling calls `scrub` on `i.content` without handling a missing content field, which can abort the feed loop.
F4: Only root-relative URLs are rewritten, leaving document-relative links unresolved and mangling protocol-relative URLs.
